description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering vacancy search parameters in the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes various properties and getter/setter methods for filtering vacancies by criteria such as job title, employee number, status, name, publication status, and vacancy IDs. It also specifies allowed sort fields for vacancy search.
